speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I can read your hand. The other two have parts, if you will lie still and be the whole house. I am the girl. I shall need the stool, or the window is only a story about a window.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The stool is the window. I am the audience, and I am not sitting up for the honour.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I am the boy. I read at a run or not at all. Judith is within, and she is not to prompt me unless I die, which I do not intend before supper.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I can't read it but I can say it. Madam! I had it at dinner, once, and once is enough if the word is Madam.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Then Madam from the stair, and only when she is called. The girl is on the stool. Begin at the name.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: O Romeo, Romeo, wherfore art thou Romeo?

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: With loues light wings did I orepearch these walls. And why has he not brought a ladder? Or a friend? A wall you mean to climb is a wall that owns a ladder, or it is a poem about a man who likes to fall.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He has the wings. He has not brought the ladder. Read on at the gallop, and save the carpentry.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I am reading at a gallop. The gallop keeps stopping for sense. A friend at the foot would have done, if the wings failed. I should have been the friend. Judith has all the easy offices.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Madam!

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: That is too soon, and too large.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Madam.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Smaller. She is inside. She is not in the yard.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Madam.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: There. That one could be inside a house. Do the large one again only if the house is on fire, and the house is not on fire.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: There is nobody left to be, so I am the moon. A candle is a moon if you are on a floor and cannot argue with a girl who has thought of it.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: You are the Nurse. The moon is already in the line. We do not need a second moon with a flame on it.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: You said there was nobody else. Nobody else is how a person gets the part. I will not be talked out of it. Madam, and also the moon. Hold the candle where he can see it, Hamnet, since you are the one with the free hand and the objections.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I am the boy under the window. I am not the candlestick. Take it yourself. My gallop requires both hands, in case of a ladder I do not have.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let her be the moon. The scene will survive a candle.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: She is too quick to say yes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She says so herself. 'Thou maiest thinke my behauior light.'

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Saying you know it doesn't mend it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. And I am changing nothing. Fold them square if you are done. The blot is still the blot, and the girl is still quick.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Is that what you do for money?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That's it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: It's better than I thought.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The moon would like to be paid as well, in anything that is not a lesson.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The boy would like a ladder in the second writing, and will not get one, because the face has gone the way it goes when a thing is finished.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Finished for today. Off the stool, Susanna, before the window becomes a fall. Judith, the candle stays a candle now. Thank you. All three. The sheet is what I am keeping.
